active_phases.name: Retire embedded /explain
active_phases.objective: Remove the explain feature from the bootstrap distribution — embedded skill copies (.claude/skills/explain, .agents/skills/explain), the --with-explain installer path, and KB API wiring — and point users at the knowledge repo's Claude Code plugin instead. Gated: starts only after the knowledge repo's P7 (Claude Code plugin) review passes; leave everything as-is until then. Rebuild the installer (python3 installer/build.py) as part of the work; likely resolves deferred D1 (hardcoded KB path/ports) by deletion.

active_phases.name: Auto-explain at phase review
active_phases.objective: Extend the phase-review machinery so a passing review also produces a phase explainer via the knowledge plugin's explain skill — review = validate + consolidate docs + explain — gracefully skipped when the skill/KB is unavailable; update the review machinery files (+ Codex mirrors, contract if touched) and rebuild the installer.
